target_text: // Dimension pair dp of the 16 tokens of block c, one token per lane.
body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

'Lanes of dead tokens are never loaded. Those lanes are zero' restates the intrinsic name _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32 (zero-masked load) and the header's contract line about masked loads. The surviving fact is the lane-to-token mapping that the mask at line 85 and the store at line 123 rely on.

Proposed:
```cpp
          // Dimension pair dp of the 16 tokens of block c, one token per lane.
```
